sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by HA immunolabeling of neonatal cochleae from Gpr156 2HA-flox/+ mice; HA signals formed a medial crescent at the apical hair cell junction identical to the pattern seen with GPR156-specific antibodies, demonstrating correct trafficking and subcellular localization. No direct signaling or electrophysiological functional assay reported in the ledger.
sites.rationale: L5 explicitly states the two HA tags were added 'at the Gpr156 start codon (N-terminal)', pinning the junction to insert_after_residue=0 (prepend before M1). GPR156 carries no signal peptide (topology: EXTRACELLULAR 1–47), so the prepended tag is immediately extracellular with 47 residues of buffer before the first TM boundary at residue 48—well above the ≥3-residue minimum. L2 confirms the design intent (epitopes on the extracellular face) and L3/L4 confirm surface display and correct apical localization in native cochlear hair cells, matching the untagged protein's known pattern. CRISPR/Cas9 knock-in mouse strain (Gpr156 2HA-flox) with two HA epitopes inserted in-frame immediately N-terminal to the Gpr156 start codon (before M1) in exon 2, using a plasmid-based donor vector in the C57BL/6J background. GPR156 has no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–47 as extracellular, so a prepend tag is directly on the extracellular face. The first TM helix begins at residue 48, giving 47 residues of clearance from the insertion point.

sources.claim: To generate the Gpr156 2HA − flox strain in the C57BL/6J background, we cloned a plasmid-based donor vector to add two HA tags at the Gpr156 start codon (N-terminal) and flank exons 2 and 3 with loxP sites.

literature_notes: All five ledger lines (L1–L5) describe the same single experiment and the same single insertion site: a dual-HA prepend before M1 of mouse Gpr156, validated in a CRISPR knock-in strain. The human GPR156 N-terminus is directly extracellular (no signal peptide; topology 1–47 = EXTRACELLULAR), making this the direct human equivalent. No other insertion sites—internal loops, C-terminus, or other extracellular domains—are described anywhere in the ledger. The four other extracellular regions (ECL1: 106–123, ECL2: 186–222, ECL3: 279–286, and the large intracellular C-tail 310–814) have no ledger support and are therefore not proposed. Validation is classified surface_only rather than surface_and_function because the ledger reports localization matching the untagged protein but no explicit signaling, hair-cell orientation, or electrophysiological assay on the tagged construct.
